label: Received esse has a distinct actual giver under source-coverage and presence (inference)
rule: Existential composition: a recipient implies a cause, then actual presence of that same cause
meaning: R1 gives a principle receiving the contingent x's esse. The already open received-esse/CAUSE_2 coverage bridge gives a distinct c causing that same x's esse. The independently open selected-world cause-presence interface then makes c exist at w. The recipient principle is not identified with c. The result is a genuine actual-giver-at-w endpoint, stronger than B2, not a proof of R1 or of either causal bridge.
